summary_hint: <borrower> LOE dated <letter_date> explaining <credit_issue_type> at <creditor> (acct ...<last4>): <one-line cause>; signed <yes/no>

typed_core.name: borrower_name
typed_core.why: identity: whose letter; attaches the LOE to a borrower for CR-5/LO-1 matching

typed_core.name: borrower_name_2
typed_core.why: identity: co-borrower when the letter is jointly authored

typed_core.name: letter_date
typed_core.why: LO-2 floor: the date component of completeness; CR-5/LO-1 recency of the explanation

typed_core.name: credit_issue_type
typed_core.why: LO-1 floor: which condition type this LOE addresses (inquiry/late/derog); CR-5 (is it an inquiry LOE)

typed_core.name: creditor_or_inquiry_company
typed_core.why: CR-5/LO-1 floor: the key that matches the LOE to the credit-report inquiry / triggering condition

typed_core.name: account_number_last4
typed_core.why: PII (restricted, last-4) + CR-5 matching key when the inquiry references an account
typed_core.prompt_hint: Last-4 of an account is PII even though partial — file it in account_number_last4, never the catch-all

typed_core.name: credit_report_bureau_or_reference
typed_core.why: CR-5 disambiguator: which bureau's inquiry this explains (same creditor can appear on multiple bureaus)

typed_core.name: event_dates_or_period
typed_core.why: CR-5/LO-1 floor: the inquiry/event date used to match the LOE to the finding; LO-2 period
typed_core.prompt_hint: Report the inquiry/event date separately from the letter date and the signature date; prefer a single ISO date when the letter states one

typed_core.name: circumstances_or_cause
typed_core.why: LO-2 floor: the explanation-text-present check; the substance of the letter
typed_core.prompt_hint: Do NOT force the prose into rigid fields — capture the cause faithfully in circumstances_or_cause

typed_core.name: amount_balance_or_payment
typed_core.why: LO-2 floor: the amount component of completeness ('+ amount if applicable')

typed_core.name: new_debt_resulted_from_inquiry
typed_core.why: CR-5 disambiguator: distinguishes 'inquiry became a new tradeline' from 'no new account' — the exact fork CR-5 evaluates
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture whether the inquiry did or did not result in new debt — read it from the text; do not infer

typed_core.name: one_time_or_recurring_indicator
typed_core.why: processor: whether the issue is isolated or a pattern (underwriter cares)

typed_core.name: resolution_or_payoff_action
typed_core.why: processor; LO-2 completeness support: what the borrower did about it

typed_core.name: current_account_orissue_status
typed_core.why: processor: current standing of the item explained

typed_core.name: supporting_documents
typed_core.why: processor; LO-2: named evidence the letter references (light string list, not a wrapped record)

typed_core.name: borrower_certification
typed_core.why: processor: the attestation clause; underwriters check it is present

typed_core.name: borrower_signature_present
typed_core.why: LO-2 floor: the scalar signature-present indicator the rule reads (catalog only has signature[])
typed_core.prompt_hint: Assess signature presence as a yes/no (AI for scans); do not judge whether the LOE is 'sufficient' — LO-1/LO-2 judge, this schema describes

typed_core.name: borrower_signature_date
typed_core.why: LO-2 floor: the signature date completeness check; distinct from letter_date

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: the loan this letter pertains to

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: the subject property address

nested_lists.name: explanation_items
nested_lists.shape_reason: one row per distinct item the letter explains (an LOE often addresses several inquiries/events)

fields.name: item_topic
fields.why: what the item is (inquiry / late / large deposit / address / employment gap)

fields.name: item_explanation
fields.why: the borrower's explanation for that item

rejected.name: document_title, form_number, form_revision_date, document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: an LOE is free-form prose, not a standardized form; classification handles type

rejected.name: issuer_name, issuer_address, issuer_phone, issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: the 'issuer' of an LOE is the borrower; captured via borrower_name

rejected.name: document_issue_date, effective_date, expiration_date, statement_period_start, statement_period_end
rejected.reason: duplicate letter_date / event_dates_or_period; an LOE has no coverage period

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses
rejected.reason: redundant — the only party is the borrower (borrower_names)

rejected.name: property_address, loan_number, account_case_reference_number
rejected.reason: not present on a credit LOE; the credit item is keyed by creditor + account last-4

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: an LOE is not notarized; borrower execution captured via the two borrower_signature_* fields

rejected.name: borrower_responsibility_orownership
rejected.reason: subsumed by circumstances_or_cause; no rule reads it separately

rejected.name: corrective_steps_and_future_prevention
rejected.reason: no consumer; catch-all captures it if stated

rejected.name: resolution_date
rejected.reason: duplicates event_dates_or_period / resolution_or_payoff_action; no rule reads a separate resolution date

encoding_variations: Issue type: stated as 'hard inquiry', 'credit inquiry', '30-day late', 'collection', 'charge-off' — credit_issue_type degrades to text; must travel beside creditor_or_inquiry_company so the matcher knows which item

The matching triple: an inquiry is identified by creditor + date + bureau — CR-5 may match on any of them, so creditor_or_inquiry_company, event_dates_or_period, and credit_report_bureau_or_reference must be captured together; one alone can match the wrong inquiry (two Capital One inquiries on different dates)

Date fields: letter_date (when the letter was written), event_dates_or_period (when the inquiry/event happened), borrower_signature_date, and resolution_date are four different dates borrowers often blur — keep them distinct
Inquiry outcome: 'no new account was opened' vs 'this resulted in a new auto loan' — new_debt_resulted_from_inquiry captures the fork; the free prose alone would force CR-5 to re-judge

open_questions.q: borrower_signature_present is not a standalone catalog field — the catalog carries only signature[] objects; LO-2's DET path needs a scalar boolean the engine can test
open_questions.recommendation: the flattened scalar + borrower_signature_date; revisit only if a rule must name each signer GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): FLATTEN signatures to signature_present + signature_date — no signature nested list.

open_questions.q: amount_balance_or_payment is an object in the catalog, flattened here to one Decimal — an LOE may reference several figures (a balance and a payment)
options: one headline Decimal + extras fall to the catch-all
open_questions.recommendation: one headline Decimal + let extra figures fall to the catch-all; flag if a rule later needs the balance/payment split

open_questions.q: event_dates_or_period is date_range with no coercer, degraded to str — CR-5/LO-1 match on the inquiry date
open_questions.recommendation: keep as str and add a prompt hint to prefer a single ISO date when the letter states one; consider a date_range coercer if many LOE/credit-report matches need range logic

open_questions.q: CR-5 is BLOCKED and the match runs on the credit-report side — the LOE only supplies match keys; confirm which key the matcher keys on
open_questions.recommendation: capture all three so we guarantee the matcher's key is always captured

open_questions.q: Shared vs specialized module — existing_extractor (letter_of_explanation.py) is one generic LOE module
open_questions.recommendation: specialize the credit variant with the fields above while keeping the generic module for other LOE subjects (employment gap, large deposit)

notes: This is the credit-specific LOE variant. Center extraction on the credit item: the inquiry/late/derogatory, the creditor, the account, the bureau.

The existing_extractor is the generic starter LOE module; this design specializes it for the credit variant. Remove referenced_employer — irrelevant to a credit LOE (belongs to the employment-gap LOE variant); no CR-5/LO-1/LO-2 consumer.

account_number_last4 is not among the 7 currently registered _PII_FIELDS keys (the registry has account_number_masked, a different key); unregistered today, a captured account number would land raw in the unmasked catch-all — register with pre_masked true.
